surfaces.title: External provider and broker contracts
evidence: Redacted contract fixtures and adapter/schema regression; no authority expansion

surfaces.title: Immutable data, PIT, reference and quality
evidence: Manifest lineage, PIT cutoff and missing/stale/conflicting data regression

surfaces.title: Research platform and expression language
evidence: Grammar/hash determinism, historical semantics and no order authority

surfaces.title: Signals, forecasts, model governance and bridge
evidence: Signal validity, immutable model identity and handoff lineage

surfaces.title: Economic semantics, pricing, risk and portfolio
evidence: Currency/horizon/cost semantics, instrument ordering and exact risk binding

surfaces.title: Account truth, accounting, ledger and reconciliation
evidence: Broker-grounded evidence, exactly-once postings and reconciliation/replay

surfaces.title: Order planning, execution, submission and recovery
evidence: Crash/retry/ambiguous-state tests and durable-before-submit; live remains separately authorized

surfaces.title: Runtime, deployment, storage and observability
evidence: Restart/recovery, locks, health and deployment scope; no implicit mode promotion

surfaces.title: Schema, migration and configuration compatibility
evidence: Code/schema/fixture parity and ordered migration/upgrade compatibility

surfaces.title: Packaging, dependencies and CLI resources
evidence: Built wheel install and resource smoke outside checkout; dependency parity

surfaces.title: CI, review and security controls
evidence: Required check names and merge_group preserved; negative tests and exact-head review

surfaces.title: Documentation, policy and acceptance evidence
evidence: Claims match implementation; evidence timestamp, scope and integration SHA

surfaces.title: Legacy boundary and deprecation
evidence: Consumer migration, historical/replay compatibility and no authority regression

cross_surface_rules.reason: Provider contracts require data/schema/test impact review
Economic changes require schema, journal/replay and documentation evidence
Migration changes require ledger/data, packaging and replay evidence
Execution changes require account/ledger and crash/recovery tests
Packaging/CI changes require install smoke and stable required checks
Research handoff requires PIT lineage and decision-semantic review
